rocco.menu.places.name: Place name
rocco.menu.personality.body: Chill: calm, with his little garden. No filter: spicier.
rocco.help.body:
Rocco follows you, defends you, drinks mate and pours you some, makes a barbecue (raw meat and coal) and tortas fritas (wheat), plays truco with you and gathers gifts for when you come back.

Tap him to open this menu. Holding something: food to feed him, armor or a weapon to equip him, a backpack to put on him.

To chat use Talk, or /rocco:decir "your message". Without AI he answers with his own lines, like in Java. His lines are in Spanish.

If he's defeated he gets buried: tap the mound to dig him out.
rocco.help.body_ai:
Rocco follows you, defends you, drinks mate and pours you some, makes a barbecue (raw meat and coal) and tortas fritas (wheat), plays truco with you and gathers gifts for when you come back.

The AI is connected: talk to him with Talk, /rocco:decir or straight in the chat.

If he's defeated he gets buried: tap the mound to dig him out.
